purpose: Human-readable and machine-readable index for V1.2 traceability records. This index is navigation and claim-ceiling metadata, not execution evidence.

records.residual_risk: Until GateSemanticsRecord and ExecutionTraceRecord are generalized across all launch-critical gates, PROG-174 may only be treated as structural validation of state semantics, not runtime execution or consequence evidence.
Until external effect evidence is received and validated, PROG-175 may only be treated as structural validation of receipt validation state, not external or physical consequence evidence.
Until external effect evidence is validated, PROG-176 may only be treated as structural validation of external effect evidence reception state, not proof of external or physical consequence.

Until physical effect evidence is received and validated, PROG-177 may only be treated as structural validation of external effect evidence validation state, not proof of physical consequence or readiness.
Until physical effect evidence is validated, PROG-178 may only be treated as structural validation of physical effect evidence reception state, not physical effect proof or readiness.
Until physical effect proof is established separately, PROG-179 may only be treated as structural validation of physical effect evidence validation state, not proof or readiness.
Until readiness gate request, validation and decision are completed separately, PROG-180 may only be treated as structural validation of physical effect proof state, not readiness.

Until readiness gate request validation, decision and decision validation are completed separately, PROG-181 may only be treated as structural validation of readiness gate request state, not readiness.
Until readiness gate decision and decision validation are completed separately, PROG-182 may only be treated as structural validation of readiness gate request validation state, not readiness.
Until readiness gate decision validation is completed separately, PROG-183 may only be treated as structural validation of recorded readiness gate decision state, not readiness.
Until readiness gate pass is completed separately, PROG-184 may only be treated as structural validation of readiness gate decision validation state, not readiness gate pass or production readiness.
Until production readiness is recorded separately, PROG-185 may only be treated as structural validation of readiness gate passed state, not production readiness or launch authority.

Until launch readiness is recorded separately, PROG-186 may only be treated as structural validation of production readiness record state, not launch readiness, certification, legal validity or procurement eligibility.

Until external customer readiness is recorded separately, PROG-187 may only be treated as structural validation of launch readiness record state, not customer readiness, banking pack readiness, certification, legal validity or procurement eligibility.

Until banking pack readiness is recorded separately, PROG-188 may only be treated as structural validation of external customer readiness record state, not banking pack readiness, certification, legal validity or procurement eligibility.

Until an external validation package is requested and independently reviewed, PROG-189 may only be treated as structural validation of banking pack readiness record state, not external validation, certification, legal validity or procurement eligibility.

Until independent external validation review is completed and accepted, PROG-190 may only be treated as structural validation of external validation package request state, not external validation acceptance, certification, legal validity or procurement eligibility.

Until independent external validation review produces an accepted outcome, PROG-191 may only be treated as structural validation of review registration state, not external validation acceptance, certification, legal validity or procurement eligibility.

Until reviewer identity and independence evidence are bound and an accepted independent outcome exists, PROG-192 may only be treated as structural validation of a not-accepted outcome record, not external validation acceptance, certification, legal validity or procurement eligibility.

Until bound reviewer identity and independence evidence are verified and an accepted independent outcome exists, PROG-193 may only be treated as structural validation of evidence binding state, not reviewer confirmation, external validation acceptance, certification, legal validity or procurement eligibility.

Until the independent review is completed and an accepted independent outcome exists, PROG-194 may only be treated as structural validation of reviewer identity and independence evidence verification, not external validation acceptance, certification, legal validity or procurement eligibility.

Until an external validation acceptance decision is recorded, PROG-195 may only be treated as structural validation of independent review completion, not external validation acceptance, certification, legal validity or procurement eligibility.
